records.request: dashboard showing how the kids improved from baseline to endline, by location and coach

attempts.raw:
{
  "title": "Child Improvement by Location and Coach",
  "subtitle": "Comparing baseline and endline performance metrics",
  "panels": [
    {
      "id": "p1",
      "kind": "table",
      "title": "Top 10 Improvers by Location & Coach",
      "sql": "WITH combined AS (
  SELECT 'baseline' AS period, "Child ID", "Location", "Coach", "Sit ups" AS sit_ups FROM baseline
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'endline' AS period, "Child ID", "Location", "Coach", "Sit ups" AS sit_ups FROM endline
), diffs AS (
  SELECT b."Child ID", b."Location", b."Coach", e."Sit ups" - b."Sit ups" AS improvement
  FROM combined b
  JOIN combined e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID"
  WHERE b.period = 'baseline' AND e.period = 'endline'
)
SELECT "Location", "Coach", improvement
FROM diffs
ORDER BY improvement DESC
LIMIT 10",
      "x": "Location",
      "y": ["Coach", "improvement"],
      "unit": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "p2",
      "kind": "bar",
      "title": "Average Shuttle Run Improvement by Coach",
      "sql": "WITH combined AS (
  SELECT 'baseline' AS period, "Child ID", "Coach", "Shuttle run sec" AS shuttle_run FROM baseline
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'endline' AS period, "Child ID", "Coach", "Shuttle run sec" AS shuttle_run FROM endline
), diffs AS (
  SELECT b."Child ID", b."Coach", e.shuttle_run - b.shuttle_run AS improvement
  FROM combined b
  JOIN combined e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID"
  WHERE b.period = 'baseline' AND e.period = 'endline'
)
SELECT "Coach", AVG(improvement) AS avg_improvement
FROM diffs
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY avg_improvement DESC",
      "x": "Coach",
      "y": ["avg_improvement"],
      "unit": "seconds"
    },
    {
      "id": "p3",
      "kind": "bar",
      "title": "Average Sit‑Ups Improvement by Location",
      "sql": "WITH combined AS (
  SELECT 'baseline' AS period, "Child ID", "Location", "Sit ups" AS sit_ups FROM baseline
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'endline' AS period, "Child ID", "Location", "Sit ups" AS sit_ups FROM endline
), diffs AS (
  SELECT b."Child ID", b."Location", e."Sit ups" - b."Sit ups" AS improvement
  FROM combined b
  JOIN combined e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID"
  WHERE b.period = 'baseline' AND e.period = 'endline'
)
SELECT "Location", AVG(improvement) AS avg_improvement
FROM diffs
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY avg_improvement DESC",
      "x": "Location",
      "y": ["avg_improvement"],
      "unit": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "p4",
      "kind": "pie",
      "title": "Distribution of Improvement Magnitude by Coach",
      "sql": "WITH combined AS (
  SELECT 'baseline' AS period, "Child ID", "Coach", "Sit ups" AS sit_ups FROM baseline
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'endline' AS period, "Child ID", "Coach", "Sit ups" AS sit_ups FROM endline
), diffs AS (
  SELECT b."Child ID", b."Coach", e."Sit ups" - b."Sit ups" AS improvement
  FROM combined b
  JOIN combined e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID"
  WHERE b.period = 'baseline' AND e.period = 'endline'
), buckets AS (
  SELECT "Coach",
         CASE
           WHEN improvement < 0 THEN 'Negative'
           WHEN improvement BETWEEN 0 AND 5 THEN 'Small'
           WHEN improvement BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN 'Medium'
           ELSE 'Large'
         END AS improvement_category
  FROM diffs
)
SELECT improvement_category, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM buckets
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY cnt DESC",
      "x": "improvement_category",
      "y": ["cnt"],
      "unit": ""
    }
  ],
  "narrative": "The dashboard provides a concise view of child improvement from baseline to endline, segmented by location and coach. Panel p1 highlights the top 10 individual improvements, offering insight into standout performers. Panel p2 shows average shuttle run time reduction per coach, indicating which coaching groups are most effective at improving speed. Panel p3 presents average sit‑ups gained per location, revealing where children collectively excel in endurance. Finally, panel p4 visualizes the spread of improvement magnitudes across coaches, helping to identify coaching styles that yield larger or smaller gains. All numeric values are represented via placeholders such as {{p1.improvement}} to ensure the narrative remains data‑agnostic."
}

records.request: build me a school dashboard - enrolment trend over years, infrastructure gaps, girls vs boys

attempts.raw:
{
  "title": "School Dashboard",
  "subtitle": "Enrolment trends, infrastructure status, and gender comparison",
  "panels": [
    {
      "id": "p1",
      "kind": "line",
      "title": "Girls enrolment trend",
      "sql": "SELECT \"School Name\", \"Girls 2022\", \"Girls 2023\", \"Girls 2024\" FROM school_enrolment_by_year ORDER BY \"School Name\"",
      "x": "School Name",
      "y": ["Girls 2022", "Girls 2023", "Girls 2024"]
    },
    {
      "id": "p2",
      "kind": "line",
      "title": "Boys enrolment trend",
      "sql": "SELECT \"School Name\", \"Boys 2022\", \"Boys 2023\", \"Boys 2024\" FROM school_enrolment_by_year ORDER BY \"School Name\"",
      "x": "School Name",
      "y": ["Boys 2022", "Boys 2023", "Boys 2024"]
    },
    {
      "id": "p3",
      "kind": "table",
      "title": "Infrastructure gaps",
      "sql": "SELECT \"School Code\", \"Toilets functional (girls)\", \"Drinking water\", \"Electricity\" FROM school_infrastructure WHERE \"Toilets functional (girls)\" = 'No' OR \"Drinking water\" = 'No' OR \"Electricity\" = 'No' ORDER BY \"School Code\"",
      "columns": ["School Code", "Toilets functional (girls)", "Drinking water", "Electricity"]
    },
    {
      "id": "p4",
      "kind": "bar",
      "title": "Girls vs Boys enrolment ratio",
      "sql": "SELECT \"Block\", SUM(\"Girls 2024\") * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(\"Boys 2024\"), 0) AS ratio FROM school_enrolment_by_year GROUP BY \"Block\" ORDER BY ratio DESC",
      "x": "Block",
      "y": ["ratio"],
      "unit": "%"
    }
  ],
  "narrative": "The dashboard provides a comprehensive view of school performance. Panel {{p1}} and {{p2}} illustrate the enrolment trends for girls and boys across 2022, 2023, and 2024, allowing educators to track growth or decline over time. Panel {{p3}} highlights critical infrastructure gaps, such as non-functional toilets for girls, lack of drinking water, and electricity shortages, which are essential for creating a conducive learning environment. Finally, panel {{p4}} presents the girls-to-boys enrolment ratio per block, expressed as a percentage, to assess gender parity in school participation. Together, these visualizations support data-driven decision-making for improving educational outcomes and infrastructure quality."
}
